text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Whew... *pant*... It's no good... I didn't 
have enough stamina left for the final 
spurt again...

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
"Accelerating for positioning... Boxing in 
the opponent so they can't slip out from 
the inside... If it comes to a contest, 
saving my own stamina instead..."

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
"Running while keeping an eye on your 
opponent means you have to control your 
own running this much...?"

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
...Think carefully, me... ...All right, 
one more time...!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Now for the next menu item. Little Cocon, 
please do three light laps around the dirt 
track.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Understood.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"...And as for Bitter Glace, let's 
actively incorporate tandem training with 
Little Cocon starting today."

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: With Little Cocon...?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
The pace management you are attempting 
right now is also Little Cocon's 
specialty. There should be a lot you can 
learn from her.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: ...... Yes, understood.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, hasn't your training changed 
lately or something?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, well... So that I can secure a solid 
win.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"...For a 'positive reason,' you don't 
look like you're having much fun. Usually 
you're making noise to the point of being 
obnoxious."

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
...Are you really okay with what you're 
doing right now?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
...It's not about being convinced or not. 
I just want to be able to win.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
Everyone around me is getting stronger and 
stronger. So much so that raw power alone 
won't be enough to catch up... Even so, I 
can't just sit here and do nothing.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
So that's why you decided to change your 
running style?

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer Kashimoto thought this through 
for me. Because she wants me to win. So I 
want to respond with all my might...!

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
...I get what you're saying, but you still 
have lingering attachments to your old 
running style, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
"For a while now, it's sounded like you've 
just been trying to convince yourself."

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
Then just say it, even once. What is it 
you truly want to do?

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text:
You know Trainer Kashimoto well, right? 
You know she's someone who takes proper 
care of her Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
It's only natural for every Umamusume to 
be different. It wouldn't be right for you 
to try and conform to them either.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
I'll revise the menu right away. In 
return, please don't hesitate to speak up 
from now on.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: They're watching me closely...

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
………… ...Understood. I'll discuss it with 
them.

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Looking good, Meek! Keep those legs 
pumping to the very end!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Good work! We did it, another new record 
time!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...*pant*... *gasp*... *phew*...

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
She's been setting new records non-stop 
lately— This is the fruit of steady, 
persistent effort! It's the result of all 
Little Cocon's hard work!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Phew... Peace...

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
...Looks like you're in great shape, 
Meek-chan.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Godolphin Barb-san! Yes! I've beat my 
time again!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
She's truly on an upward streak! It's like 
everything she's stored up over the past 
two years since her debut is bursting out 
all at once...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"...I've always believed we should go at 
our own pace. However, after day after day 
of just watching the other Umamusume 
around us grow and develop—"

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
I feel like I've made Meek feel frustrated 
so many times.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
"Still, that's precisely why we are where 
we are today...! The fruits of our 
perseverance are blooming all at once...!"

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...I held it in... ...That's why I'm doing 
my best... Mun.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, Meek! To have blossomed so 
thoroughly... Winning a graded race this 
year is no longer just a dream!

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
"...Still, your growth over such a short 
period is practically unprecedented."

text_block_list.name: Godolphin Barb
text_block_list.text:
That's precisely why it's important to be 
cautious. Don't suddenly increase 
training, and don't overlook even the 
slightest change in physical condition.

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. Without slacking on self-care, and 
taking our training step by step...!

text_block_list.name: Trainer Kiryuin
text_block_list.text:
And during the Senior year, I'm going to 
do tons of things with Meek that we 
couldn't do before!

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Stronger... ......Much, much 
stronger...

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
"...Win the race... ...and make both 
myself and Trainer happy..."

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
............ ...Fufu, Trainer... you're 
way too happy...

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text: ...Alright.

text_block_list.name: Happy Meek
text_block_list.text:
...Keep pushing... ......More, even 
more...
